refs: SAP Help: Fiori Elements OData V4 — Confirmation Popups (strict handling)
Other cause with the same 412: ETag not refreshed by the behaviour (StormShynn/sap-error-codex rap-draft-save-412-precondition-failed-etag, not verified here)
title: RAP action shows a 'Warning … Proceed anyway?' popup instead of a red error (HTTP 412)
symptom: Fiori Elements (OData V4) action: dialog titled 'Warning' with the ABAP message + 'Proceed anyway?' and Execute / Cancel, although the handler reported a severity-error message. Network: HTTP 412.
rootCause: FE sends actions with 'Prefer: handling=strict'. A blocking message in REPORTED without a matching FAILED entry makes RAP answer 412; FE renders its own confirmation popup (title and text are FE's, not the ABAP message). Pressing Execute re-sends the same request WITHOUT the header, so the handler runs a second time (duplicate external calls / documents). A state message (%state_area) breaks it.

solutions.label: Persist the per-row result instead of a %msg
solutions.body: For mass/staging screens: write a status criticality column + an abap.string message column, report no %msg -> no popup, results survive. FAILED would roll back everything the request wrote.

solutions.label: Real hard error
solutions.body: Fill FAILED together with REPORTED (transition message). Trade-off: the changeset rolls back, including values written for other, successful rows.

solutions.label: Switch strict handling off in the app
solutions.body: manifest.json: disableStrictHandling: true (per app or per action).

prevention: Decide per action: hard error (FAILED) or persisted result column — never REPORTED alone for errors. Make handlers that call external APIs idempotent (document-creation-pattern.md step 7).
evidence: memory rap-failed-vs-reported-412-popup (observed 2026-08-24, Public Cloud DEV tenant)

occurrences.target: (old workspace, action calling an external API)
